title: Computational design of metalloproteases
title_zh: 金属蛋白酶的计算设计
abstract: De novo design of enzymes that cleave amide bonds represents a major challenge1,2. Here we use RFdiffusion methods3,4 to de novo design proteins with water-activating zinc-based active sites adjacent to a peptide substrate binding pocket. Of 135 designs tested, 36% catalyse cleavage of their cognate peptide substrates at the targeted scissile bond. The best design accelerates peptide-bond hydrolysis by more than 108-fold relative to the uncatalysed reaction; four substitutions increase this acceleration to more than 1010-fold by improving active-site preorganization5. We use this approach to design metalloproteases that selectively cleave the human disease-associated proteins TDP-43, amyloid-β and serum amyloid A, with rate enhancements of up to 109-fold. We further design caged cytokines and receptor antagonists that are selectively activated by the designed proteases, enabling bioorthogonal control of cell state. Thus, de novo design can yield highly active, programmable proteases with applications in therapeutics, biotechnology and bioremediation.
abstract_zh: 去氨键的酶去设计是一个主要挑战1,2。此处，我们利用 RFdiffusion 方法3,4 去去设计具有水激活锌基活性位点且毗邻肽底物结合口袋的蛋白质。在测试的 135 种设计中，36% 在目标裂解键上水解其特异性肽底物。最佳设计使肽键水解速率相对于非催化反应加速超过 108 倍；四个氨基酸替换通过改善活性位点预组装，使这种加速提升至超过 1010 倍5。我们利用此方法去设计选择性水解人类疾病相关蛋白 TDP-43、β-淀粉样蛋白和血清淀粉样蛋白的金属蛋白酶，加速度高达 109 倍。此外，我们去设计了可被这些设计的蛋白酶选择性激活的被捕获细胞因子和受体拮抗剂，从而实现对细胞状态的生物正交控制。因此，去设计可以产生高活性、可编程的金属蛋白酶，在治疗、生物技术和生物修复等领域具有应用前景。
